decision_reason: No scene establishes the required visual and uncapped-soft advantage over both front-depth and no-ID depth distribution in three fixed views. E_occ meets the numeric ID-null proxy in all views, but that cannot replace the failed visual criterion. E_layer and shape have no qualifying three-view joint numeric ID criterion at the primary grid.

diagnostics/chair_mechanisms_0.png.findings: High capture and small residual. K and first-ID texture follow upholstery/frame; expected/front depths retain smooth chair form.

diagnostics/chair_mechanisms_1.png.findings: Variance/layer count and overflow show localized upholstery/back patches; entropy/turnover contain texture; W1 clipped display dense.

diagnostics/chair_mechanisms_2.png.findings: First mass layer dominant, rear layers localized to seat/back/frame patches; depth maps separate these supports.

diagnostics/chair_mechanisms_3.png.findings: Stable split support follows upholstery/back patches, not a clean line family. Near-complete target map; retained-alpha loss localized.

diagnostics/drums_mechanisms_0.png.findings: High capture with small diffuse tail. K increases on rims/stands; first-ID tessellation dense. Depth maps distinguish cymbals and drum bodies.

diagnostics/drums_mechanisms_1.png.findings: Variance and layer count strong in localized drum/cymbal patches; overflow sparse. W1/turnover include many internal structures.

diagnostics/drums_mechanisms_2.png.findings: First layer dominates kit; rear layer masses localized inside selected drums/cymbals and along supports.

diagnostics/drums_mechanisms_3.png.findings: Mass transitions trace many rims plus internal patches; stable split concentrated in a few drum/cymbal areas. Target nearly reached everywhere, retained-alpha holes local.

diagnostics/ficus_mechanisms_0.png.findings: High overall capture, small diffuse residual. Larger K on foliage; fine ID tessellation diagnostic only. Depth maps retain leaf/pot/stem geometry.

diagnostics/ficus_mechanisms_1.png.findings: Variance/split complexity concentrated in foliage; entropy/turnover textured, W1 display saturated. Overflow very sparse.

diagnostics/ficus_mechanisms_2.png.findings: First layer dominant; second/rear layers scattered through foliage and small pot regions.

diagnostics/ficus_mechanisms_3.png.findings: Stable splits scattered in foliage/pot. Target misses sparse foliage pixels, not broad areas. Retained/native alpha predominantly high.

diagnostics/lego_mechanisms_0.png.findings: High alpha capture; residual diffuse and small. K highlights studs and edges. First-ID tessellation is not line evidence; front/expected depths broadly agree.

diagnostics/lego_mechanisms_1.png.findings: Variance concentrates at some model boundaries; entropy and ID turnover carry substantial interior structure. W1 display saturates. Overflow localized at base/wheels.

diagnostics/lego_mechanisms_2.png.findings: First layer dominates; rear layers concentrate around wheels/base and structural transitions. All four mass/depth maps inspected.

diagnostics/lego_mechanisms_3.png.findings: Front-mass transitions outline model and studs; stable split support sparse and localized. Target almost everywhere reached; retained mass holes coincide with overflow.
